_comment: The AI Agent City index registry (blueprint v2, approved sha 441bc3b4a1d1) — the trust-and-outcome map every machine index surface is generated from: /llms.txt products section, /v1/products enrichment, openapi x-products, the root Accept:application/json block, and the 404 index payload all read THIS file via city_index.py. Adding a row here changes every rendered index. slot/direction values are verbatim from BLUEPRINT.md v2's product table — never invent new categories. The master fleet registry (which this file's product set mirrors) is ~/AI-Workbench/projects/product-skill-surface/registry.json — a build-side file that does not exist in the deploy container; this vendored copy is the deployable source of truth for index rendering. Keep the product SET equal between the two; id spellings may differ (master `trust-scan` vs vendored `trustscan`, matching CITY_CATALOG), and free_proof copy may be tightened here for index rendering.
